intro.description: Project management is the practice of planning, organizing, and guiding work from start to finish — ensuring the right things get done, on time, and within budget. In a world where businesses juggle competing priorities at every turn, it has become one of the most essential disciplines driving efficiency, innovation, and results across every industry.
intro.badgesAlt: ESM, ESM-P, and ESM-A certification badges

whyMatters.title: Why Scrum Master Matters
whyMatters.point1: Organizations lose an average of 11.4% of their investment due to poor project management — Scrum Masters directly reduce that risk.
whyMatters.point2: Scrum Masters act as a shield for their teams, enabling developers to focus on delivering value without distraction.
whyMatters.point3: They foster a culture of transparency, inspection, and adaptation — the core pillars that make Agile transformation sustainable.
whyMatters.point4: Certified Scrum Masters are consistently linked to faster delivery cycles, higher team morale, and measurable productivity gains.

whoShouldLearn.title: Who Should Learn
whoShouldLearn.point1: You don't need a specific degree — anyone with a passion for collaboration and continuous improvement can become a Scrum Master.
whoShouldLearn.point2: Team leads and project managers looking to transition from command-and-control to servant leadership.
whoShouldLearn.point3: Developers or QA engineers who want to expand their impact beyond technical tasks.
whoShouldLearn.point4: Business analysts and product stakeholders who want to better understand and support Agile delivery.
whoShouldLearn.point5: HR professionals and organizational coaches driving culture and change management programs.
whoShouldLearn.point6: Recent graduates and career changers seeking an in-demand, globally recognized Agile credential.

careerOpportunities.title: Career Opportunities
careerOpportunities.point1: Demand for skilled project managers and Scrum Masters is growing across all industries — tech, healthcare, finance, and beyond.
careerOpportunities.point2: Certified Scrum Masters command a significant salary premium compared to non-certified practitioners.
careerOpportunities.point3: The role opens pathways to Agile Coach, Release Train Engineer, and Head of Delivery positions.
careerOpportunities.point4: Global organizations actively recruit ESM holders to lead digital transformation and hybrid Agile programmes.
careerOpportunities.point5: With ESM, ESM-P, and ESM-A you build a structured career path with a recognized credential at every stage.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: The Endorsed Scrum Master (ESM) is the foundation-level certification for professionals beginning their journey in Agile and Scrum. It validates your understanding of core Scrum principles, roles, events, and artifacts — equipping you to support Agile teams confidently from day one. Issued by the Institute of Scrum, this lifetime credential establishes your credibility with employers and prepares you for advanced certifications along the Scrum Master path.

keyLearning.point2: Understand the servant-leadership mindset and the responsibilities of a Scrum Master.
keyLearning.point3: Facilitate key Scrum events including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Review, and Retrospective.
keyLearning.point4: Apply Agile values and empirical process control to real team scenarios.
keyLearning.point5: Identify and remove impediments that block team progress and flow.
keyLearning.point6: Build a foundation for continuous improvement and high-performing teams.
